name: MEP Coordination — Clash Judge
description: Takes an IFC model, finds true clashes and clearance violations in MEP services, triages by congestion and programme, and proposes sourced resolutions on a clone. The original model is never written to.

run_coordination_pass.description: Full pipeline: load -> judge every admitted pair -> evaluate clearance rules -> triage into a prioritised queue -> propose resolutions -> export BCF -> clone. The default action for a bare 'run clash detection' request.

detect_clashes.description: Load an IFC model and judge every element pair the padded AABB pre-filter admits. Returns hard clashes, clearance violations, clear pairs, and unjudged pairs.

check_clearance.description: Evaluate already-judged findings (or a specific element pair) against the sourced clearance rule table. Every violation cites the rule_id and clause it was judged against.

triage_queue.description: Turn a findings list into a deduplicated, prioritised remediation queue ordered by resolution stage, programme date, congestion, and severity.

propose_resolution.description: Propose a checked, sourced move for one queued clash, or refuse and flag/escalate it. Never applies the move.

export_bcf.description: Write clash and clearance findings as a BCF 2.1 issue package (.bcfzip) for Navisworks / Solibri / BIMcollab.

diff_versions.description: Compare two clash-detection runs on the same model and bucket every element pair into resolved / new / regressed / persisting.

apply_to_clone.description: Write proposals as a change_set.json plus a modified IFC copy (or a Speckle commit when configured), never touching the original model.

blocks.description: Exact clash and clearance judgement from one pass over IFC meshes. Padded AABB is a pre-filter only; the verdict comes from real triangle meshes.
Sourced minimum-gap rules and the violations they judge. A rule without source.clause and source.text_hash is refused at load, never silently dropped.
Dedupe, classify, and rank findings into a queue an engineer will actually work, in the resolution order recorded in order.yaml.
Propose a re-checked, sourced move for one queued clash, or flag/escalate it. No LLM in the decision path; gravity services keep their fall.
Write a validated BCF 2.1 package from clash/clearance findings for hand-off to coordination tools.
Compare two clash runs on the unordered element-pair key and bucket outcomes into resolved / new / regressed / persisting.
Write a change set and a modified clone (IFC copy, or Speckle when configured). The original IFC is opened read-only and is hash-identical before and after.

helpers.description: Not a block: loads and meshes an IFC model for the blocks above. Separated because parser work full of schema-version quirks should not need to live in every geometry test.

reads: IFC file path (IFC4 or IFC2X3 only)
writes: a modified clone of the IFC (or a Speckle commit when configured)
never: writes to the original IFC model or any authoring tool
proposes a move that cannot be sourced to a rule without flagging it unsourced
reports an element with no geometry as clear
loads a clearance rule missing source.clause or source.text_hash
invents a clearance value or a citation

requires.note: manifold3d supplies the boolean backend. Without it the engine degrades to surface intersection and every affected finding records method='surface_intersection' rather than 'exact_boolean'.
